description: A dim, candlelit night scene of a crowd of men in 19th-century dark suits and top hats, plus clergy in white and gold vestments, gathered at the edge of a pit. A large rough stone block hangs from ropes over the pit. On the right, workers lean over a wooden trestle table holding a model of a spired, tall-towered church. Torches and lanterns light the scene, with a city skyline under a cloudy dusk sky in the background. I see no legible text, no frame or border, and no gore.
